title: Pick the **outbox** store
text:
The repo already runs [@Postgres](https://github.com/acme/relay/blob/HEAD/db/schema.ts) for jobs, so an outbox table costs **no new service**.

Which should I build?

- **Postgres outbox**: one table, polled every 2 s
- **Redis streams**: lower latency, one more thing to run

title: Sign-in outage, root cause
text:
Google's token endpoint answered **503** for about 9 minutes, starting 14:02 UTC.

Our retry ran *once* with no backoff, so every sign-in in that window failed. [@Sentry issue](https://vespin.dev/stage/inbox/abc) has the trace.

I opened [@#9661 Back off on token refresh](https://github.com/acme/relay/pull/9661) with exponential backoff and a test that fails without it.
